Entry watch is $19.20 with invalidation $19.80; the only downside air is to the lower Bollinger band ~$18.39 / prev_day_low $18.95 before a wall of demand — hourly pivot_lows are volume-confirmed at 18.96 and 19.25, both within ~1-2% of the trigger. A stop above 19.80/19.91 risks ~$0.60-0.70 for roughly ~$0.25-0.80 of reward into support = approximately 1:1 or worse. The easy money is gone.
